notes: PAB-MUMBAI-ENVPROP-VADA-PAV-CART-V1, umbrella-open-cart right-edge master. Session 48 applied the same deterministic style-correction pipeline used on the fixed-canopy masters. Source v001 canvas is 573x937, alpha>=32 bbox (102,219)-(469,679), including 3,384 sub-alpha-8 dust pixels and a baked ground-contact shadow under the wheels (same visual defect family as the other three carts). Correction: alpha cleanup keeps only a Gaussian-smoothed (sigma 1.5) alpha>=200 core plus a 4px Euclidean dilation, then original alpha values restored for surviving pixels. Result: dust 3,384->792 (remaining are legitimate edge antialiasing, verified visually), contact shadow removed, alpha>=32 bbox tightens by 3px at the bottom (679->676) - the shadow's blend zone here, not cart structure (wheels/umbrella ribs/gas cylinder all intact, verified visually). Style flattening: cv2.pyrMeanShiftFiltering (sp=18, sr=45) + light bilateral + PIL contrast x0.78 / saturation x0.75 / brightness x1.06 - identical parameters to the fixed-canopy corrections, for family consistency. Measured: Laplacian-std texture 72.1->55.7, greyscale-contrast std 64.1->48.6, mean HSV saturation 153->99 (the umbrella's red/blue/yellow stripes were the most saturated element in the whole vada-pav family; now visibly closer to the game's muted palette). IMPORTANT: this record is style-correction only, not a placement approval - like v001, this asset has never been through a Session-46-style controlled measurement/placement test. Dimensions/anchor stay at the disabled-draft 0/0 sentinel. Do not wire this into EDGE_PROP_DEFS or a runtime pool without that measurement pass first. Superseded from mumbai_prop_vadapav_cart_umbrella_open_cart_right_neutral_1x_v001, kept unmodified on disk for traceability.
